Key and common settings
Every ID is one mirrored triangular pair, completed for all ten layers before moving to the next ID.
Each speed group runs left to right: 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0 mm nominal triangle tip spacing.
Rows 1–2 use nominal width 0.162876 mm; rows 3–4 use nominal width 0.15 mm. Flow 1.4 throughout.
Every first layer prints at 5 mm/s, including objects whose later layers print at 7.5–25 mm/s.
Original triangle shapes retained and uniformly scaled. Straight intro/outro remain 10 mm; baseline gap ≥1 mm.
Part fan OFF layers 1–3; then 40–90% by estimated layer time: 30s → 40%, 12s → 90%. Auxiliary fan OFF.
*Fan values in the object key are approximate lower percentages for layers 4–10; exact per-layer PWM is in the CSV.
Deposition acceleration: 500 mm/s² first layers, 2000 mm/s² afterward. XY purge-line extrusion: 20 mm/s.
M900 K0.55 L1000 M10. Flow ratio is baked into E once; M221 stays at 100%. Physical width requires measurement.
Plate envelope: X21.83–240.70, Y23.85–231.15 mm. Model height 0.60 mm; travel Z1.00.
Fan timing is an estimate including movement, wipe and unretraction. Labels and colors are not printed.
Static checks passed. Physical printing of this new array remains unverified.
